anchor: Develop the user's ongoing Variational Garrote sparse autoencoder; diagnostic work is subordinate to method development.

core_claims.claim: Exact combination of input-amortized Bernoulli support and point amplitude with a learned linear dictionary and analytic VG objective.
core_claims.delta: Support-only variational averaging plus input-dependent point amplitude is jointly amortized and trained as a one-pass modern SAE; no exact published duplicate found.

core_claims.claim: No support sampling or hard-threshold STE is required for this linear-decoder training objective.
core_claims.verdict: True implementation property; no generic novelty
core_claims.delta: Estimator route differs from sampled VSC, thresholded VSC and probabilistic TopK; analytic VI is established.

core_claims.claim: VG support/amplitude/noise coupling can improve sparse feature quality or the accuracy-cost tradeoff.
core_claims.verdict: Method contribution hypothesis; not yet established
core_claims.delta: Show a measurable effect of Bernoulli inclusion cost and exact support variance beyond known no-shrinkage or adaptive-L0 properties.

queries: "spike and slab sparse coding" "Goodfellow" variational paired mean field

recent_six_months.limitations: Search date filters returned some older results; publication/submission dates were distinguished. Not a complete arXiv dump.

sources.title: The Variational Garrote
sources.read_level: Primary PDF main objective and Appendix C; primary abstract/publisher search
sources.comparison: Direct ancestor of support expectation, point coefficients, variance and precision; no current amortized learned-dictionary SAE.

sources.title: Spike and Slab Variational Inference for Multi-Task and Multiple Kernel Learning
sources.read_level: Primary PDF section 3 paired family and analytic EM
sources.comparison: Stochastic slab paired with support; analytic VI is prior art.

sources.title: Large-Scale Feature Learning With Spike-and-Slab Sparse Coding
sources.read_level: Primary PDF sections 2–3, variational factors and coordinate/parallel inference
sources.comparison: Learned linear dictionary and analytic structured support/slab VI; iterative inference rather than present point-amplitude feedforward encoder.
sources.publication_status: ICML 2012; expanded TPAMI 2013 checked via PubMed DOI 10.1109/TPAMI.2012.273

sources.title: Variational Garrote for Statistical Physics-based Sparse and Robust Variable Selection
sources.read_level: Primary HTML abstract and method
sources.comparison: Autodifferentiated VG regression ancestor, no exact SAE duplicate found.

sources.title: Variational Garrote for Sparse Inverse Problems
sources.read_level: Primary HTML and publisher indexed page
sources.comparison: VG inverse-problem work, not amortized sparse autoencoding.
sources.publication_status: Publisher indexed result: Journal of Computational Science 2026

sources.title: Improving Sparse Decomposition of Language Model Activations with Gated Sparse Autoencoders
sources.read_level: Primary HTML methods, shrinkage results and related work
sources.comparison: Selection/magnitude separation is prior art; no Bernoulli KL plus exact variance objective.

sources.title: Jumping Ahead: Improving Reconstruction Fidelity with JumpReLU Sparse Autoencoders
sources.read_level: Primary HTML sections 3–4
sources.comparison: Hard sparsity and threshold STE; no current probabilistic support objective.
sources.publication_status: preprint version checked; final venue not independently checked

sources.title: Scaling and evaluating sparse autoencoders
sources.read_level: Primary HTML plus inherited method table
sources.comparison: Per-input TopK and low shrinkage; strong baseline, no VG Bernoulli free energy.
sources.publication_status: preprint version checked; final venue not independently checked

sources.title: BatchTopK Sparse Autoencoders
sources.read_level: Primary HTML short paper plus inherited method table
sources.comparison: Batch sparsity budget permits variable per-input L0; adaptive L0 not novel.

sources.title: Probabilistic TopK Sparse Autoencoder for Interpreting the Activations of Large Language Models
sources.read_level: Original PDF search-index extraction section 3.2 Eq. 7–8; direct PDF browser challenge
sources.comparison: Binary Concrete score plus magnitude leads to TopK mask; ordinary MSE; no Bernoulli KL or analytic support-averaged risk.
sources.access_limit: Direct PDF and forum blocked; code gradient implementation unverified

sources.title: Sparse Autoencoders, Again?
sources.read_level: Primary HTML section 3 Eq. 4, prior VAE objective and Appendix D.3
sources.comparison: VAEase uncertainty-derived gate (1-sigma) times Gaussian latent, learned observation variance; no Bernoulli support KL or point amplitude.

sources.title: Learning Sparse Codes with Entropy-Based ELBOs
sources.read_level: Primary HTML sections 2–3 and Appendix D.3
sources.comparison: Analytic sparse coding, noise profiling and amortized optimization already exist; Gaussian posterior/Laplace prior differs from Bernoulli/point VG.

sources.title: Variational Sparse Coding
sources.read_level: Primary PDF section 3, Eq. 5 stochastic reconstruction and Eq. 7 warmup
sources.comparison: Amortized spike/slab with stochastic slab, mixture prior and sampling; no exact current point-amplitude combination.

sources.title: Variational Sparse Coding with Learned Thresholding
sources.read_level: Primary PDF methods, STE appendix and linear-dictionary experiments
sources.comparison: Thresholded continuous latent samples with STE; different risk/gradient route.

sources.title: Sparse-Coding Variational Autoencoders
sources.read_level: Primary publisher indexed body sections 2–3 and discussion; metadata via PubMed
sources.comparison: Overcomplete linear model with feedforward Gaussian recognition; fixed observation noise in reported experiment; Bernoulli exact-zero posterior absent.
sources.access_limit: Direct PMC browser challenge; official publisher indexed body read

sources.title: Variational Sparse Paired Autoencoders (vsPAIR) for Inverse Problems and Uncertainty Quantification
sources.read_level: Primary HTML sections 2.2–3.1, concrete relaxation and setup
sources.comparison: Bernoulli spike plus Gaussian slab and slab KL, hard-concrete/STE and paired nonlinear inverse task.

sources.title: Analysis of Variational Sparse Autoencoders
sources.read_level: Primary HTML section 2.2 and abstract
sources.comparison: Fixed-unit-variance Gaussian, mean L2 KL and sampled TopK; negative evidence does not transfer to VG automatically.

sources.title: SoftSAE: Dynamic Top-K Selection for Adaptive Sparse Autoencoders
sources.read_level: Primary HTML method including Eq. 4–8 and late hard training
sources.comparison: Capacity MLP plus SoftTopK; adaptive L0 and soft/hard deployment already studied, no VG free energy.

sources.title: Feature Starvation as Geometric Instability in Sparse Autoencoders
sources.read_level: Primary abstract and metadata
sources.comparison: Adaptive elastic-net SAE is adjacent competition for differentiability/shrinkage; no exact Bernoulli VG signature in abstract.

sources.title: Rational Sparse Autoencoder
sources.read_level: Primary arXiv indexed abstract
sources.comparison: Trainable rational activation from existing SAE; competition for encoder improvement, no exact VG signature in abstract.
